references.title: Expression of leukotriene receptors in the rat dorsal root ganglion and the effects on pain behaviors.
references.note: rat DRG: CysLT2 mRNA in small neurons, co-localised with TRPV1 and P2X3; the only paper on this receptor in a pain pathway, inflammatory pain, not OA

references.title: Characterization of the human cysteinyl leukotriene 2 receptor.
references.note: human CysLT2 cloned and expressed in oocytes and HEK293T cells: LTC4 activates it and raises intracellular Ca2+, with high affinity and LTC4 = LTD4 > LTE4

references.title: The CysLT(2)R receptor mediates leukotriene C(4)-driven acute and chronic itch.
references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.note: mouse sensory neurons and human DRG: LTC4 acts through CysLT2R; CYSLTR2 detected in human DRG neurons (itch, not pain: LTC4 gave itch and no pain behaviour)

nodes.label: CYSLTR2
props: G protein-coupled receptor GPCR21; G protein-coupled receptor HG57; HPN321
Receptor for cysteinyl leukotrienes. The response is mediated via a G protein that activates a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system.

nodes.label: LTC4
props: A leukotriene that is (5S,7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-5-hydroxyicosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid in which a glutathionyl group is attached at position 6 via a sulfide linkage.

references.title: Expression of leukotriene receptors in the rat dorsal root ganglion and the effects on pain behaviors.
references.note: rat: LTC4 alone caused no pain, but pretreatment strongly increased the pain evoked by the P2X3 agonist alpha,beta-methylene-ATP; the drawn statement, inflammatory pain, not OA

references.title: P2X3 and P2X2/3 Receptors Play a Crucial Role in Articular Hyperalgesia Development Through Inflammatory Mechanisms in the Knee Joint Experimental Synovitis.
references.note: rat knee joint, carrageenan synovitis (an inflammatory model, not OA): blocking articular P2X3 and P2X2/3 attenuates the hyperalgesia, so endogenous ATP acts on P2X3 at the knee's nociceptive afferents

references.title: Correlation of changes in pain intensity with synovial fluid adenosine triphosphate levels after treatment of patients with osteoarthritis of the knee with high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid.
references.note: 28 human knee OA patients: synovial fluid ATP, the agonist of P2X3, falls with pain after hyaluronic acid and the two changes correlate

references.title: Bone marrow derived mast cells injected into the osteoarthritic knee joints of mice induced by sodium monoiodoacetate enhanced spontaneous pain through activation of PAR2 and action of extracellular ATP.
references.note: mouse MIA knee OA: mast cells injected into the OA joint raise spontaneous pain, and apyrase (ATP removal) suppresses it: extracellular ATP carries pain in the OA joint

references.title: Molecular characterization and pharmacological properties of the human P2X3 purinoceptor.
references.note: human P2X3 cloned: a fast ATP-gated cation channel, agonist order 2MeSATP > ATP > alphabeta-meATP
